svg.title: The FIC_0_PERIPHERALS canvas in Libero, with numbered callouts that light up in turn: the project's own pfdaq_core block, its AXI4-Stream outputs, the DMA controller's stream input, the two latency interrupts, the APB register port, and the DMA initiator that carries the writes towards DDR.
svg.desc: The FIC_0_PERIPHERALS canvas in Libero, with numbered callouts that light up in turn: the project's own pfdaq_core block, its AXI4-Stream outputs, the DMA controller's stream input, the two latency interrupts, the APB register port, and the DMA initiator that carries the writes towards DDR.

g.text: pfdaq_core: the block this project adds
Plain Verilog, instantiated next to the vendor's IP. Clock, reset and one APB slot come in on the left.
TDATA (64 bit), TVALID, TLAST, TKEEP, TSTRB and TDEST leave the block; TREADY comes back.
Each stream signal is wired one to one into AXI4StreamTarget_IF.
IRQ_LAT0 and IRQ_LAT1 leave the block; the DMA's own interrupt is DMA_CONTROLLER_IRQ.
APB_TARGET is the project's slot in the APB address range (0x4000_0Fxx).
DMA_INITIATOR carries the DMA's AXI4 writes to the fabric interface, and from there to DDR.
